name: cache-ttl-compact
description: Shows a countdown to prompt-cache expiry in the status line and runs /compact while the cache is still warm

ttl.title: Cache TTL
ttl.description: Prompt-cache TTL (usually 1h; 5m when usage goes into overage)

marginSeconds.title: Compact margin (seconds)
marginSeconds.description: How many seconds before expiry to compact

minContextTokens.title: Min context tokens
minContextTokens.description: Skip compaction below this context size (re-caching it is cheap)
